Anthony Gordon.note: Gordon has become England's late-game accelerator, assisting both Kane goals against DR Congo. He makes tired defenders face one more sprint and one more cross.
Anthony Gordon.noteZh: 戈登已经成为英格兰比赛后段的加速器，对刚果民主共和国两次助攻凯恩。他让疲劳防守者再面对一次冲刺和一次传中。

Bukayo Saka.note: Saka has supplied England's biggest runners, assisting Rashford and Bellingham. Even managed carefully, his first touch gives England a cleaner final action.
Bukayo Saka.noteZh: 萨卡已经为英格兰最重要的跑动者送出助攻，包括拉什福德和贝林厄姆。即使被谨慎管理，他的第一下触球也让英格兰最后一脚更干净。

Dan Burn.note: Burn is England's size card on the left side of defense. He matters if Norway turn the match into crosses, set pieces, and Haaland traffic.
Dan Burn.noteZh: 伯恩是英格兰左侧防线的身材牌。如果挪威把比赛变成传中、定位球和哈兰德周围的混战，他就有价值。

Dean Henderson.note: Henderson is England's sharp goalkeeper cover behind Pickford. His role is readiness: claim crosses, restart quickly, and keep the box loud.
Dean Henderson.noteZh: 亨德森是皮克福德身后的敏锐门将保障。他的角色是随时准备：摘传中、快速重新开球，并让禁区保持清晰指挥。

Declan Rice.note: Rice is England's safety net behind the Kane and Bellingham story. His assist against Croatia showed he can start attacks, but his main value is killing counters early.
Declan Rice.noteZh: 赖斯是凯恩和贝林厄姆故事身后的安全网。他对克罗地亚的助攻说明他能发动进攻，但最大价值是尽早掐掉反击。

Djed Spence.note: Spence has been used for right-back speed in England's rotation. He is there when the flank needs a runner who can chase forward and back.
Djed Spence.noteZh: 斯彭斯在英格兰轮换中提供右后卫速度。当边路需要能前后都追的跑动者时，他就有意义。

Eberechi Eze.note: Eze is England's dribble answer when the block refuses to move. He changes the angle himself instead of waiting for the pass to do it.
Eberechi Eze.noteZh: 当对手低位不动时，埃泽是英格兰的带球答案。他会自己改变角度，而不是等传球来改变。

Elliot Anderson.note: Anderson has quietly started much of England's run and assisted Bellingham against Croatia. He keeps the midfield pressure alive without demanding the spotlight.
Elliot Anderson.noteZh: 安德森安静地首发了英格兰多场比赛，并在对克罗地亚时助攻贝林厄姆。他不抢镜，却让中场压力持续存在。

Ezri Konsa.note: Konsa has been England's steady centre-back through the run. His value is clean positioning while the full-backs and midfielders take the louder roles.
Ezri Konsa.noteZh: 孔萨是英格兰这段征程中的稳定中卫。他的价值是干净站位，让边后卫和中场承担更显眼的任务。

Harry Kane.note: Kane has been England's closer, scoring in every knockout tie so far. He drops to connect, then still finds the box when the match needs the finish.
Harry Kane.noteZh: 凯恩是英格兰的收官者，目前每场淘汰赛都有进球。他会回撤连接，但比赛需要终结时仍会回到禁区。

Ivan Toney.note: Toney is the physical forward route if England need to change the game state. He gives Kane support, penalty-box contact, and another set-piece target.
Ivan Toney.noteZh: 如果英格兰需要改变比赛状态，托尼是身体型前锋路线。他给凯恩支援、禁区对抗，也提供另一个定位球目标。

James Trafford.note: Trafford is young goalkeeper depth for England. This tournament card is about cover and distribution upside, not a likely quarter-final role.
James Trafford.noteZh: 特拉福德是英格兰年轻门将深度。这届赛事中，他的卡片更多是保障和出球潜力，而不是八强战主线。

Jarell Quansah.note: Quansah has filled the right-back slot in England's rotation despite being a centre-back by trade. That tells you the staff value his calm and size.
Jarell Quansah.noteZh: 宽萨虽然本职是中卫，却在英格兰轮换中补过右后卫。这说明教练组看重他的冷静和身材。

John Stones.note: Stones is England's route from defense into midfield when he is used. He gives the back line a passer who can step forward without making it look risky.
John Stones.noteZh: 斯通斯出场时，是英格兰从防线进入中场的路线。他给后防线提供一名能前顶传球、却不显得冒险的球员。

Jordan Henderson.note: Henderson is England's game-management voice. If the last 20 minutes get ragged, he gives the midfield instructions as much as touches.
Jordan Henderson.noteZh: 亨德森是英格兰管理比赛的声音。如果最后20分钟变得混乱，他给中场的不只是触球，还有指令。

Jordan Pickford.note: Pickford remains England's tournament keeper. The saves matter, but so does the direct pass that lets England skip pressure and find Kane early.
Jordan Pickford.noteZh: 皮克福德依然是英格兰的赛事门将。扑救很重要，但他直接找凯恩、帮助球队跳过压力的传球同样重要。

Jude Bellingham.note: Bellingham has turned England's pressure into goals, especially the two-minute burst against Mexico. He is the midfielder opponents lose when Kane drags them away.
Jude Bellingham.noteZh: 贝林厄姆把英格兰的压力变成进球，尤其是对墨西哥两分钟内的爆发。当凯恩把防守者带走时，他就是对手漏掉的中场。

Kobbie Mainoo.note: Mainoo is England's calm-in-traffic midfielder. If Norway's pressure arrives through the middle, he can carry out instead of forcing the first pass.
Kobbie Mainoo.noteZh: 梅努是英格兰在人群中保持冷静的中场。如果挪威从中路压上，他可以带球出来，而不是勉强传第一脚。

Marc Guehi.note: Guehi has helped settle England's knockout back line. He reads the channel early, which matters against Haaland's first movement and Norway's second runners.
Marc Guehi.noteZh: 格伊帮助英格兰淘汰赛防线稳定下来。他很早读到通道，这对防哈兰德第一步和挪威第二波跑动很重要。

Marcus Rashford.note: Rashford gives England the direct run that changes a tired back line. His Croatia goal came from the simple thing he still does best: arrive before the defender turns.
Marcus Rashford.noteZh: 拉什福德给英格兰提供改变疲劳防线的直接跑动。他对克罗地亚的进球来自他最擅长的简单动作：在防守者转身前到达。

Morgan Rogers.note: Rogers gives England a stronger carrying option between midfield and attack. He is the choice if the match needs someone to run through contact.
Morgan Rogers.noteZh: 罗杰斯给英格兰提供中前场之间更强壮的推进选择。如果比赛需要有人带球穿过对抗，他就有意义。

Nico Oreilly.summary: Nico O'Reilly is an England midfielder from Manchester City who gives the national team midfield height, late box arrivals, and left-footed progression.
Nico Oreilly.note: O'Reilly has been trusted at left-back in England's reshuffled defense. His card is about height, composure, and doing an unfamiliar job cleanly.
Nico Oreilly.noteZh: 奥赖利在英格兰重组防线中被信任踢左后卫。他的看点是身高、冷静，以及把不熟悉的位置完成得干净。

Noni Madueke.note: Madueke has started several matches as England's one-on-one winger. He gives the attack a player who wants to beat the defender, not just recycle the ball.
Noni Madueke.noteZh: 马杜埃凯已经多次作为英格兰一对一边锋首发。他给进攻提供一个想过人而不是只回传的球员。

Ollie Watkins.note: Watkins is England's runner behind the line. If Kane drops and the defense follows, Watkins is the option that turns the empty space into a race.
Ollie Watkins.noteZh: 沃特金斯是英格兰冲击防线身后的跑动者。如果凯恩回撤而防线跟出，沃特金斯就是把空当变成冲刺的选择。

Reece James.note: James gives England the strongest right-back delivery in the squad when fit. Against Norway, his crosses would force defenders to watch Kane and the far runner at once.
Reece James.noteZh: 健康时，詹姆斯给英格兰提供队内最强的右后卫传中。对挪威时，他的传球会迫使防守者同时盯凯恩和远端跑动者。

Trevoh Chalobah.note: Chalobah is defensive flexibility for England's bench. He can protect the right channel or add centre-back depth if the match becomes about defending the box.
Trevoh Chalobah.noteZh: 查洛巴是英格兰替补席上的防守灵活性。他能保护右侧通道，也能在比赛变成禁区防守时增加中卫深度。
